create_s3_path_handler: create an S3PathHandler instance to manage S3 file operations with optional cache directory and transfer config
open_s3_file_read: open an S3 file in read mode and return a file-like object for reading text or binary data
open_s3_file_write: open an S3 file in write mode and upload contents to S3 when the buffer is closed
get_local_s3_cache_path: get a local cached file path for an S3 URI by downloading and caching the remote object
copy_local_to_s3: copy a local file to an S3 URI using the S3PathHandler upload functionality
